Initial release of YieldShark: DeFi stablecoin yield monitor.

- Real-time APY tracking for USDT, USDC, and DAI across 50+ DeFi platforms on 7 major chains
- Smart filtering: excludes LP pools, filters APY outliers and low TVL
- Offers platform risk ratings, gas estimation, yield comparison, and net APY calculations
- Includes free and paid query tiers with wallet addresses for payments
- Multiple CLI scripts and npm commands for monitoring, comparing, and reporting yields
